test_list.description: Generated u16 schema versions accept legacy payloads only in versions 1/2 and new lifecycle payloads only in version 2.
Configuration, pause and resume events roundtrip in schema 2 while Event stays fixed-size Copy.
Existing schema-1 session events retain their original schema on decode.
A new lifecycle event in a schema-1 envelope is rejected.
Versioned construction rejects zero/future schemas and preserves valid old schemas.

inputs.name: event
inputs.description: A fixed-size session lifecycle event with configuration text held in CAS.
